product.name: Monoprice 0.8 mm/HPDB68M VHDCI 0.8mm SCSI Cable - 3ft  Offset Assy Type
product.description: VHDCI SCSI cables with 68-pin 0.8mm to High Density D-Sub 68 pin (HPDB68) connector for connecting SCSI storage devices and other compatible peripherals.  VHDCI stands for Very High Density Cable Interconnect.   This cable features an assembly type offset connector on the 0.8mm connector side which means that the connector has a two piece shell that is held together by screws and the connector is not centered on the face of the connector housing.
